publication: Local commits only; no push, tag, registry publication or deployment.

contracts.selection: Whole visible image/table/rule only. Native immutable proof and exact publication guard precede planning. Other selections reject rather than collapse.
contracts.delete: Prefer requested logical neighbor then opposite. A sole direct child or no surviving visible stop inside the actual parent requires an explicit fresh empty paragraph at the old slot. Neighboring atoms may remain node selections. Cell/caption navigation domains are retained. The supplied floor identity is unused otherwise. Pending styles clear.
contracts.plainReplacement: One fresh plain paragraph at the original slot, caret at the exact UTF-16 end with plain pending formats. Empty explicit input intentionally replaces with an empty paragraph; no Unicode normalization or inherited caption/cell styles.
contracts.typing: Separately enabled first-key replacement starts a new Insert continuation, never joins a prior burst, and later caret typing may share its native group. Empty user input proves source then publishes nothing and consumes no ID. Recovery restores groups but no live clock.
contracts.history: Local original ReplaceBlocks inverse retains the full source. Shared original InsertBlocks/DeleteBlock form one selective group. Peer source edits and replacement text remain causal across creator Undo/Redo and restart. No asset-store deletion.
contracts.limits: Shared insertion is admitted before source hiding and requires transient node/text headroom; a smaller final tree alone is insufficient. Failure retains checkpoint, frame and causal version. Local replacement needs final-tree headroom. Shared replacement retains a 64 KiB input-byte ceiling.
contracts.capability: Separate local atomEditVersion and shared atom_edit_version string1. Local closed deleteAtom/replaceAtomPlainText/replaceAtomTypingText requests; shared guarded corresponding methods. SDK requires exact capability and all shared methods without JS transaction fallback. Flow-navigation capability is unchanged.
contracts.browser: V2 stock controllers route deletion, Cut, plain paste, first printable keys and matching beforeinput to Rust. Key routing follows widget/composition/modified-key/read-only guards and cancels its default. Read-only includes non-BMP keys; empty paste retains the selection. V1 stock atom routing remains original. Structured clipboard placement stays separate.
contracts.compatibility: No document, schema, shared model, journal, frame or checkpoint version changed. New conveniences persist only original action/command and typing-partition meanings. Actual pre-capability Wasm restores and reproduces their future history.

native.rootCountScope: All workspace features, including diagnostic/experimental features; not the narrower previous checkpoint's feature set.
native.unchangedDependencyWarning: Vendored HasIdSpan unused import; vendor source untouched.

installed.policy: Every discovered SDK file once in the final run; Chromium, Firefox and WebKit, one worker, zero retries, unchanged 60-second case and 300-second process limits. Application matrix follows serially on the same installed consumer. Temporary bounded sleep assertion, no permanent power change.

eventDelivery.before: All three engines, both owners, selected image: zero DOM ranges, one trusted Q keydown and keypress, no beforeinput or input, source and node selection unchanged. Injecting beforeinput reaches the existing native planner and produces one correct paragraph/history unit in all six cases.
eventDelivery.after: All six repaired cases record one trusted prevented keydown, one-character paragraph/caret and one native Undo unit. The default does not author a duplicate.
eventDelivery.scope: Repeatable editor event-routing repair, not a historical WebKit engine/startup repair. No OS clipboard, input-source or accessibility settings used.
